summary.value: Village Vanguard is the legendary basement jazz club on Seventh Avenue South in Greenwich Village.

description.value: Village Vanguard is a legendary jazz club in a tiny basement at 178 7th Ave S in Greenwich Village. It runs two shows nightly at 8pm and 10pm, with admission plus a one-drink minimum. There is no food, so eat beforehand and buy tickets online before they close an hour ahead.
